properties.description: Fires when APIM rejects more than 5 requests per 5 minutes with x-block-reason matching jailbreak or indirect prompt injection. Scoped via diagnostic settings to the AI Hub APIM instance only.

allOf.query: ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where ResponseCode == 403 | where isnotempty(LastErrorReason) | where LastErrorReason has 'jailbreak' or LastErrorReason has 'IndirectAttack' or LastErrorReason has 'prompt-shield' | summarize Count = count()
